source.text: Histological/cytological diagnosis of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
Clinical stage IB, IIA/IIB, or III (N0-2) amenable to surgical resection.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST) 1.1.
No active invasive malignancy in the past 2 years other than non-melanoma skin cancer.
Participants with known EGFR mutations, ALK translocation, or ROS1 translocation.
Participants with known EGFR mutations, ALK translocation, or ROS1 translocation.
Participants with known EGFR mutations, ALK translocation, or ROS1 translocation.
Prior therapy with an anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L-1, or anti-PD-L2 agent.
Known active Hepatitis B (e.g., HBsAg reactive) or Hepatitis C (e.g., HCV RNA \[qualitative\] is detected).
Known history of, or any evidence of active, non-infectious pneumonitis.
Uncontrolled infection with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV) or HCV infection; or diagnosis of immunodeficiency.
Active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years (i.e. with use of disease modifying agents, corticosteroids or immunosuppressive drugs).

Pregnant or breastfeeding, or expecting to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the trial, starting with the pre-screening or screening visit through 120 days after the last dose of study treatment.

Myocardial infarction having occurred less than 6 months prior to study enrollment, any known uncontrolled arrhythmia, symptomatic angina pectoris, active ischemia, or cardiac failure not controlled by medications.
